title: "Coordinate Systems"

audience: physics

last-reviewed: "2026-10-30"
---

This chapter describes the coordinate and placement concepts used by OPALX
and a proposed extension based on named ports and a geometry graph. Current
OPALX provides rigid element placement, element-local field frames, and `LINE`
and `RING` sequences. General named-port connections, patch objects, graph
assembly and time-dependent rigid placement are design proposals, not current
input interfaces.
